input.objective:
Launch Pondside (POND) with a Uniswap v4 hook on Robinhood Chain, paired with ETH.
Token: Pondside (POND), the standard launch token: 1,000,000,000 supply, 18 decimals, plain transfers, no owner functions.
The hook does exactly the following, and nothing else:
1. Take 1.0% of the ETH side of every buy as a hook fee, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and send it to 0x5Bff2a2FEcD1d6152676813b21346238733bEAB1. Expose claimFees() that anyone may call to redeem claims to the recipient.
2. The hook fee starts at 10.0% of the ETH side of every swap when the pool opens and decreases linearly to 0.5% over the first 30 minutes, then stays at 0.5%. Expose currentFeeBps() as a view.
No owner functions, no backend signer, no upgrade path.
Fees are always taken from the ETH (pair currency) side, never from POND; a fee the PoolManager cannot pay directly is minted as a claim the recipient can redeem.
Enable beforeInitialize (required by the IMD launch factory) and only the callbacks the behavior above needs. Take the PoolManager as a constructor argument. Owner, if any, is $owner.
Pool: 50% of my 90% share seeds the pool; the remainder goes to the paying wallet.
Keep the function names exactly as written so the storefront can show them. Composed with The Hooks Store block builder.

facts.assumed: Assumed: nobody can change it after deployment.

facts.label: Outside services and values
facts.example: e.g. Chainlink VRF subscription 1234, or: the owner sets the feed after launch

facts.label: Which pool: the one this launch opens for its new token, with the hook attached
When the hook acts: when its pool opens, as every launch hook must, and on each swap if it takes a fee, plus whatever else you describe
Hook fee: any fee the hook takes is taken in ETH on each swap, unless you ask otherwise. When the pool is short of ETH, the hook holds it as a claim and collects it later
Transfers: plain, with no fees, limits, pausing or minting
Split: 10% to the swarm, the other 90% is yours: 50% into the pool, the rest to your wallet
Pool: paired with ETH, opening at a 10 ETH market cap
Trading fee: 1.25% of every trade: 1% to you, 0.25% to IMD, claimable any time. The hook's own fee, if it takes one, is on top; "no fees" means the hook takes none
